This book is a collection of essays written by Ma Jiahui in midlife—a long, reflective journey about home and travel. Life, love, journeys... Ma pours his thoughts, feelings, and realizations into these pages. It is both a contemplation and commentary on the many facets of life, as well as a personal reflection on the passage of time. From youth to middle age, it traces a visible path of growth and maturity. Many people long for maturity yet fear the process of growing up. In this book, you catch a subtle glimpse of a middle-aged man's evolving self—his maturity and transformation. Lighthearted yet sharp, humorous yet vivid, the writing captures the moving and emotional moments hidden in everyday life
